item.title: Another Tanker Is Attacked Near the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: The ship was struck near an Emirati port, in the first such attack in five days. The United Arab Emirates also said it was intercepting Iranian drones and missiles.

item.title: Sucked Into War, Gulf Countries Face the Limits of U.S. Security Guarantees
item.summary: Barraged by Iranian attacks and questioning the value of security ties with the United States, nations in the Gulf have turned to Ukraine, Australia and Italy for help.

item.title: As War With Iran Hurts Oil Prices, U.S. Turns to Iranian Boats for Help
item.summary: Iranian-linked ships carrying Russian oil were among those that received temporary exemptions from sanctions, a sign of how dire the energy crisis is becoming.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Monday
item.summary: President Trump said he might postpone a trip to China to focus on the war. More than a million people have been displaced in Lebanon this month, according to the country’s health ministry.

item.title: What Are Trump’s Positions on Iran? They Can Change by the Sentence.
item.summary: The president is no stranger to staking out contradictory stands, part of what his aides say is his negotiating style. But on Iran, his shifting positions are colliding with the consequences of war.

item.title: In Choosing ‘Epic Fury,’ Trump Names a War and Defines His Presidency
item.summary: The branding of the U.S. military operation against Iran is a quintessentially Trumpian choice for a leader whose tenure has been marked by anger.

item.title: Israeli Schools Begin Reopening in Some Areas Seen as Safer
item.summary: Some classes resumed on Monday in areas far from the populous cities and border regions that have come under attack in the conflict with Iran and the Iran-backed militia, Hezbollah.

item.title: Israel’s Expanding Ground Assault in Lebanon Meets Resistance in Hilltop Town
item.summary: The town of Khiam’s location on high ground just a few miles north of the border between Israel and Lebanon has made it coveted territory over multiple conflicts.

item.title: With Iran War, Trump Risks Stepping on Gains From His Own Tax Cuts
item.summary: President Trump’s war in Iran has raised some costs just as many Americans are starting to see savings from last year’s tax cuts.

item.title: Israel Denies That It Is Running Out of Missile Interceptors
item.summary: Israeli military says it had prepared for a prolonged conflict after a news report said its supplies of ballistic missile interceptors were running “critically low.”
